prompt: A hotel chain wants to reduce operating costs. The candidate's framework: (1) Staff costs; (2) Energy and utilities; (3) Supplies and laundry; (4) Guest satisfaction scores from last year. What is the flaw in this framework?

options.text: Bucket 4 doesn't matter as a cost bucket
options.feedback: Right. Satisfaction is a check on any cut, not a source of savings. Replace it with maintenance and other costs.

options.text: Buckets 2 and 3 overlap and should be merged
options.feedback: Utilities and supplies are separate cost lines.

options.text: It is a generic cost tree
options.feedback: The cost lines fit a hotel. The flaw is bucket 4.

explanation: Cost buckets should be costs: staff, utilities, supplies, maintenance, overhead. Guest satisfaction is a constraint on the cuts.

extras.corrected_framework: Staff; utilities; supplies and laundry; maintenance; overhead (with satisfaction as a constraint)
